title: Quantum element-wise transforms
summary: Quantum algorithms for basic numerical linear algebraic tasks have proven essential for translating diverse problems to a unified quantum computational context. Many of these tasks---e.g., applying a function to the spectrum of a matrix embedded in a unitary process (a so-called block encoding), or taking linear combinations of block encodings---are well-addressed by techniques like quantum singular value transformation or linear combination of unitaries.
